extra.reason: Implemented dual-sensor ingress: SyntheticFrameSource (test/dev only, no real capture backend in this container), DualSensorSynchronizer (hardware-timestamp align with <1-frame skew tolerance, raises SensorSyncError/SensorStarvedError, never silently drops), and RingBuffer (120-frame window, is_full/dropped_frame_count, raises FrameGapError/FrameReorderError). 17/17 unit tests pass incl. an integration test sustaining the 120-frame window through an injected NIR frame drop, and a test asserting the pipeline never opens a socket. See sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-9x6.md for full details, spec-inconsistency note (sec 2 vs 4.1 frame rate), and what remains unbuilt (real V4L2/NIR capture backends).

Implemented LabNormalizer (src/ov1/preprocess/lab.py): CLAHE contrast stretch on a*/b* only, L passed through untouched. Self-check + unittest suite verify L bit-identical to unstretched conversion, a*/b* histogram range/std widened on synthetic turbid footage, and mutation is channel-selective. clip_limit/tile_grid_size are required constructor args (no default) per site-calibration rule. Full suite: 27 tests, OK.

Implemented: cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK sparse tracker over L-channel with site-supplied pixel->metre homography, drift-tolerant re-seeding, and a synthetic-clip sanity check on known drift direction. 22 new tests pass; full suite 49/49.
DoLP computation, glare mask, and tests implemented and passing per acceptance criteria

Implemented InferenceTensorAssembler (src/ov1/tensor/assemble.py): stacks per-frame [L,a*,b*,DoLP] planes into the spec 4.2 (1,4,120,1080,1920) tensor, downscales via cv2.resize, fixed channel order documented via CHANNEL_ORDER constant, and attempts torch pin_memory() for the Jetson handoff (honestly reporting pinned=False + reason on this no-CUDA container). 87 tests pass in 0.392s including a real-4K-to-1080p smoke test and a network-isolation test. Filed 2 follow-up beads (ocean-vision-v1-0h8 ingress->tensor glue, ocean-vision-v1-3hw channel-scale normalization) for out-of-scope work discovered.

Implementation and tests already existed in the tree (committed in 62c7328) matching the bead's description exactly: window_assembly.py wires RingBuffer.window() -> LabNormalizer/compute_stokes/compute_dolp/SpecularGlareMasker -> FrameChannels.from_lab_and_dolp() -> InferenceTensorAssembler, with SiteCalibrationConfig.from_json_file() answering the per-site clip_limit/tile_grid_size/dolp_threshold question. Verified by reading the code, checking every collaborator signature it calls against the real implementation, and running the full suite: 110 tests pass in 0.449s, including a network-isolation test on this exact glue path. The bead was left in_progress by a prior session that finished the work but never closed it. Handoff: sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-0h8.md

Already implemented and committed by a prior session (commit 62c7328, src/ov1/tensor/assemble.py): L/a*/b* (uint8 [0,255]) divide by 255.0 onto DoLP's native [0,1] range, chosen over per-channel z-scoring because /255 is a fixed property of the uint8 encoding while z-scoring would need per-site baseline stats this container can't fit. Decision + rationale documented in the module docstring and inline comments, verified by 20 passing tests in tests/test_tensor_assemble.py + test_tensor_no_network.py. This session verified correctness and wrote the handoff; no code changes needed. See sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-3hw.md.

Verified prior session's already-committed backbone code against acceptance criteria; added the missing tests/test_backbone_no_network.py to make the 'loads offline with network disabled' criterion an automated, repeatable test. Full suite: 155 tests, 154 passing (1 pre-existing unrelated failure in ocean-vision-v1-4ci's uncommitted work).

Verified prior session's uncommitted rip_current.py + tests against spec 4.3 and this bead's acceptance criteria. Direction gate derives seaward strictly from a required, validated ShorelineNormal (no default); magnitude (0.5 m/s) and channel-width (15m) gates enforced with spec's own numbers as overridable defaults; homography and shoreline_normal are required calibration inputs with no defaults; fails loud on non-finite input, non-positive dt_s, or non-unit-length normal; no-network test confirms the update() path never opens a socket. 24/24 rip-current-specific tests pass; full suite 178/179 (1 pre-existing unrelated failure in ocean-vision-v1-4ci's uncommitted dataset work, not touched here). 'validated on annotated rip footage' criterion could not be met -- no footage of any kind exists in this container -- documented plainly in the handoff, following the same precedent as ocean-vision-v1-bag's close.

Implementation (src/ov1/data/manifest.py, src/ov1/data/dataset.py) was already complete and committed (in 62c7328, under an unrelated commit title) by a prior session that claimed this bead but never closed it. Found and fixed the one bug blocking closure: tests/test_data_dataset.py's test_non_overlapping_windows_by_default called ds._index_start(i), a method that never existed -- fixed to read the dataset's real internal _index list directly. All 3 acceptance criteria verified against code + tests: correctly-shaped windows (BaselineWindowDataset via InferenceTensorAssembler), documented provenance/exclusion gating (ClipProvenance + gate_baseline_clips allow-list, fail-loud on malformed manifest rows), held-out split isolation (GatedManifest.included_train/included_held_out, tested end-to-end). Full suite: 179/179 tests pass. No production code changed. Handoff: sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-4ci.md

Implemented SpatiotemporalAutoencoder (src/ov1/model/autoencoder.py): symmetric Conv3D encoder / ConvTranspose3d decoder, exact-shape-preserving reconstruction (kernel=4/stride=2/pad=1 halves/doubles H,W exactly; T preserved by default per the design note's spatial-only downsampling scope), MSE train_autoencoder() training loop, and a measure_inference_latency() utility. Forward-shape and training-loop-convergence acceptance criteria verified by 16 new tests against synthetic tensors and a synthetic gated baseline corpus (full suite 195/195, up from 179/179). Third acceptance criterion (latency measured against 250ms on target hardware) cannot be met in this container -- no GPU, no Jetson, documented as unverified at every level (module docstring, LatencyMeasurement dataclass, test comment) rather than silently claimed. Handoff: sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-133.md
